game_title: Safe Get Scout – Wind Pass Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Frost Peaks – Wind Pass, a howling mountain pass: the summit pilot must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Wind Pass: a howling mountain pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Wind Pass, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the summit pilot ahead. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cliff anchor by solving code steps involving safe_lookups that move the summit pilot forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cliff anchor first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Safe Get Scout' (Week 8 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Wind Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Wind Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
